title: "Benchmarks"

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

This vignette compares base R and MLX timings across core matrix routines.

```{r libraries}
library(Rmlx)
library(bench)
library(ggplot2)

helpers_path <- system.file("benchmarks", "bench_helpers.R", package = "Rmlx")
if (!nzchar(helpers_path)) {
  fallbacks <- c(
    file.path("inst", "benchmarks", "bench_helpers.R"),
    file.path("dev", "benchmarks", "bench_helpers.R")
  )
  helpers_path <- fallbacks[file.exists(fallbacks)][1]
}
if (is.na(helpers_path)) {
  stop("bench_helpers.R not found. Ensure the package is installed or the inst/benchmarks directory is available.")
}
source(helpers_path)
```

```{r benchmark}
sizes <- c(small = 500L, medium = 1000L, large = 2000L)
inputs <- build_benchmark_inputs(sizes)
operations <- benchmark_operations()

bench_results <- run_benchmarks(operations, inputs)

bench_results$size <- factor(
  bench_results$size,
  levels = names(sizes),
  labels = sizes
)
bench_results$implementation <- factor(
  bench_results$implementation,
  levels = c("base", "mlx"),
  labels = c("base R", "mlx")
)
bench_results$operation <- factor(
  bench_results$operation,
  levels = vapply(operations, `[[`, character(1), "label")
)
```

```{r plot}
ggplot(
  bench_results,
  aes(x = size, y = median_seconds, colour = implementation, group = implementation)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("base R" = "#4A4A4A", "mlx" = "#D63230")) +
  facet_wrap(~ operation, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Benchmarks for common matrix operations",
    subtitle = "Time taken (less is better)",
    x = "Matrix size",
    y = "Median time (seconds)",
    colour = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## History

```{r benchmark-history, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("DESCRIPTION"))
benchmark_path <- "dev/benchmarks/bench_results.tsv"
git_args <- c("-C", shQuote(repo_root))
benchmark_refs <- character()
if (file.exists(file.path(repo_root, ".git")) && nzchar(Sys.which("git"))) {
  # Local builds use master; CI checkouts may only have origin/master.
  benchmark_refs <- system2("git", c(
    git_args, "for-each-ref", shQuote("--format=%(refname)"),
    "refs/heads/master", "refs/remotes/origin/master"
  ), stdout = TRUE)
}

history_results <- list()
if (length(benchmark_refs)) {
  history_log <- system2("git", c(
    git_args, "log", "--first-parent", "--reverse", shQuote("--format=%H %ct"),
    benchmark_refs[1L], "--", benchmark_path
  ), stdout = TRUE)
  if (length(history_log)) {
    history_commits <- read.table(
      text = paste(history_log, collapse = "\n"),
      col.names = c("commit", "timestamp")
    )
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(history_commits))) {
      snapshot <- system2("git", c(
        git_args, "show", paste0(history_commits$commit[i], ":", benchmark_path)
      ), stdout = TRUE)
      # The existing TSV is whitespace-separated, with a units line above its header.
      timings <- read.table(text = paste(snapshot, collapse = "\n"), header = TRUE, skip = 1L)
      for (size in names(timings)[-1L]) {
        history_results[[length(history_results) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          commit = history_commits$commit[i],
          date = as.POSIXct(history_commits$timestamp[i], origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
          operation = timings$op,
          size = as.integer(sub("^n", "", size)),
          median_ms = timings[[size]]
        )
      }
    }
  }
}
history_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(history_results)

if (nrow(history_results)) {
  history_plot <- ggplot(history_results, aes(date, median_ms, colour = factor(size))) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ operation, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Benchmark history on master",
      x = "Commit date",
      y = "Median time (milliseconds)",
      colour = "Matrix size"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(history_plot)
} else {
  cat("Benchmark history is available when building from a Git checkout with master's history.\n")
}
```


## Distribution Functions

Distribution functions operate on vectors rather than matrices, so we benchmark them
at larger sizes: 1,000, 100,000, and 10,000,000 elements.

```{r dist-benchmark}
dist_sizes <- c(small = 1000L, medium = 100000L, large = 10000000L)
dist_inputs <- build_distribution_inputs(dist_sizes)
dist_operations <- distribution_operations()

dist_results <- run_benchmarks(dist_operations, dist_inputs)

dist_results$size <- factor(
  dist_results$size,
  levels = names(dist_sizes),
  labels = format(dist_sizes, scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ",")
)
dist_results$implementation <- factor(
  dist_results$implementation,
  levels = c("base", "mlx"),
  labels = c("base R", "mlx")
)
dist_results$operation <- factor(
  dist_results$operation,
  levels = vapply(dist_operations, `[[`, character(1), "label")
)
```

```{r dist-plot}
ggplot(
  dist_results,
  aes(x = size, y = median_seconds, colour = implementation, group = implementation)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("base R" = "#4A4A4A", "mlx" = "#D63230")) +
  facet_wrap(~ operation, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution function benchmarks",
    subtitle = "Time taken (less is better)",
    x = "Vector length",
    y = "Median time (seconds)",
    colour = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
